evening.caption:
Season has just landed on Earth, and he wants to see all of it ☀️

Season is the bright Yang spirit. He doesn't wait to be shown around; he jumps in, runs, flies and goes to look for himself. A sunlit hilltop, rolling hills and a river, then the edge of a cliff and an ocean bigger than anything he has seen. In people, this Yang side is the part of you that says "let's go and see" before you have all the answers. Curiosity with energy behind it is how new places get explored.

If you could explore anywhere tomorrow, where would you go first? Tell us below 👇
